description: Launch publicity creates a strong but decaying traffic burst.
A partial listing outage suppresses marketplace visits.
A creator campaign increases D2C traffic and discounting.
A delayed electronic cap component increases replenishment lead time.
A defective production batch raises returns and lowers review scores.
A transparent recall temporarily reduces demand for affected colours.
Courier capacity falls, causing delays and cancellations.
A lower-priced competitor puts pressure on conversion.
AquaVanta responds with a time-limited promotion.
